Name: (AT) Hundred Idle Serpent Statues
Author: Tiyara
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Adds a number of re-coloured versions of green and purple serpent statues, and their mirrored counterparts.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I basically just used the colours of existing vanilla furniture and decorative items and applied them to the original Serpent Statues because I needed some more colour in my game. Enjoy![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]All you need is SMAPI, Alternative Textures and the Paint Bucket that adds to the game. Oh, and a Purple or Green Serpent Statue, of course.[/size][/color]

[b][size=4]Other mods seen in the above screenshots, in alphabetic order:[/size][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7454]Kat's Brighter Hair[/url] (1st and 2nd pic)
